name: SA-V-128-Benchmark
description:
SA-V-128 Benchmark Testset
	

The SA-V-128 Benchmark Testset is introduced in the paper Through-The-Mask: Mask-based Motion Trajectories for Image-to-Video Generation by Yariv et al. (2025). This benchmark is designed to evaluate image-to-video generation models with a focus on motion complexity, particularly distinguishing between single-object and multi-object motion scenarios.
For further details, please refer to the original paper and the project page.

evaluation_method: FVD (Fréchet Video Distance) and human evaluation
reputation: New benchmark introduced by Yariv et al. to evaluate image-to-video motion complexity; currently limited adoption but relevant to the image-to-video research community.
